edit.title: Edit Me
edit.content: Click a cell to change its title and idea. Nothing is saved, so a refresh resets everything.

drag.title: Drag Me
drag.content: Drag a cell onto another one to swap them.

modes.title: Switch Modes
modes.content: Use the buttons above: the left one makes the cells read only, the right one lets you edit them again. Clear a cell with the X in its corner.
